title: cerastium erectum var. octandrum
intro: Cerastium erectum var. octandrum, commonly known as Eight-flowered St. Peters-wort, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and other respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of Cerastium erectum var. octandrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
